headline: Proteome-scale mapping of protein expression, structure, and function in bacteria
label: Proteome Scale Protein Annotation
summary: Pooled yield assays, dual-sgRNA CRISPRi screens, and whole-proteome predictors now generate protein-level data at proteome scale for reuse.
synthesis: The dominant thread is proteome-scale generation and standardization of protein-level data for reuse. ProtoPure extracts 12 standardized purification parameters from literature across UniProt proteomes. A pooled assay quantifies monomeric E. coli yield for more than 39,000 proteins, benchmarks inverse folding methods, and trains the ESMC-MonoYield predictor. Structure and function predictors are integrated into a sequence-to-function pipeline that annotates the whole E. coli UTI89 proteome and releases a public resource with host-microbe and microbe-phage interaction pathways. A dual-sgRNA CRISPRi platform separately maps essential-gene genetic interactions in M. smegmatis and M. tuberculosis, a more experimental strand that shares the scale but not the structural focus. What is new is the scale and standardization of these data for reuse, rather than a single new computational method; the work does not share one method.
